labeledStatementExpressionExecution.assertion: three recursively labeled terminal forms execute identically in the C-HIR and EvoIR interpreters

implementationFacts: Each function that lexically uses __func__ or __FUNCTION__ gets one implicit static const char[N] object; __PRETTY_FUNCTION__ reports E2921.
Statement-expression result discovery recursively strips labels and is shared by the front end, C-HIR interpreter, and lowering.
Array parameters are adjusted once while preserving written bracket qualifiers and static in the declarator record.
Pointers to corresponding signed and unsigned integer pointee types, including the three character types, convert in every declared context while genuinely incompatible pointer types remain E2202.
One shared modifiable-object predicate rejects arrays, top-level const objects, and aggregates containing const members without treating pointee qualifiers as qualifiers of the pointer object.
Static address constants compose through constant member/index projections, decay, strings, __func__, and pointer-width-safe casts.

fullConfigurationSurvey.scopeDiscipline: The rerun was measure-only; none of its new typed diagnostic frontier was fixed.

processDeviations: The first __func__ implementation allocated an implicit SymbolId in every function, including functions that never used the identifier. The full workspace gate caught fourteen frozen identity/fingerprint regressions before commit. The accepted implementation first scans the body and creates the object only when lexically required; a regression test pins declaration and SymbolId order.

An exploratory change that executed goto while testing labeled statement-expression results exceeded the declared rule and was removed before commit. The accepted change only makes the terminal-value query recursive through labels.

One attempted layout gate was unusable: restricted container access failed and a later git-diff command in the same shell masked the nonzero status. It was rejected. Fresh sequential permission-correct base and attributed runs produced 128/128 and 22/22 ORACLE_CONSENSUS.

The final documentation-only gate was first started without the established temporary runner. Every completed target was green, but macOS provenance scanning imposed the known per-binary delay; the run was interrupted and is not evidence. The complete 1118/1118 rerun used the isolated /private/tmp runner and exited zero.
claimCeiling: The six declared parser rules pass, the 16-unit dashboard stays 48/48 clean, and the full target-unit survey has zero panic, timeout, or unavailable units. The remaining 353 diagnosed units are an open typed frontier, not general parser conformance.
